files.document_title: Viola Project general location map, Exhibit F, Southern Star Central Gas Pipeline, January 2026
files.what_it_shows: Proposed Line UA as a red line running west from a compressor station at N Seneca Road near Cicero to a meter station west of Anson in Sumner County, Kansas. The map prints the start and end coordinates.
Page 1 rendered at 150 dpi. The line runs almost due west with one small jog near the middle.

searched: The oilandgaswatch record and its attached documents.
notes: The oilandgaswatch record page is a JavaScript application shell, so the URL checker cannot read it. The geometry comes from the site's data record, which was saved in fetched_layers/ogw. The oilandgaswatch geometry is graded Medium by that site. The map prints both endpoint coordinates, which can be used to check the vector ends.
